entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling because I need to make a return for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. Just so I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the band or more of a personal preference?

Oh, no, it works fine. It's just... I honestly just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy after the holidays, and I really don't use it. I feel awful about it, but I was hoping I could get the money back.
I understand completely. Let's see what we can do. Can I get your full name and the order number to pull up your account details?
Of course. It's Alex Chen, and the order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Alex. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 33 days ago.
Yes, that sounds right. I was so worried I waited too long. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and I really, really need this money back.
No need to worry at all. I've just checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's such a huge relief. Thank you so much, Sarah! You have no idea how much this helps me out.

It's my pleasure, Alex. And I see here you're a VIP member with us, so we definitely want to take care of you. I'm emailing the prepaid return label to you right now. Just attach that to the original box and drop it at any post office.
That's perfect. I can do that this afternoon. You've been wonderful.
I'm happy to help. As a thank you for your loyalty, I've also added a $15 credit to your account for any future purchase. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Wow, a credit too? Thank you! No, that's everything. I really appreciate your help.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
